coding.note: Released X-MOD models and code are stated on page 2. Architectural and from-the-start training comparisons are coded PARTIAL conservatively: active parameters and training steps are controlled, but total model capacity differs; the adapter comparison is also staged differently. Five random-seed runs are reported, without explicit across-run uncertainty. CC100 and language sampling are disclosed, but not a complete numerical mixture. GPU count alone does not meet the compute criterion; update steps alone do not disclose tokens. Only SHARED appears as a comparator in the main results tables; adapter baselines occur in secondary figures. No rename coded: the modules terminology explicitly distinguishes joint pre-training from post-hoc adapters.

seeds.quote: All results are averaged across 5 random seed runs.
